name: assembly-newsh2-123
summary: Grey two-legged ground pylon, 22 x 28 px from two 2x2 pieces, mirror symmetric: a tall grey head housing at the top holds a square blue light in a frame, with a grey collar band below it and shoulders sloping out; from it a glowing blue glass tube runs down the middle to row 14; two round grey legs hang from the shoulders, each with a domed hip carrying a blue pipe that loops out sideways and down the outside of the leg, a blue trim strip down its inner edge, and a dark curved foot edged in blue; between the legs a recessed dark bay holds machinery (a gear and a short shaft). Shape language: hard chamfered grey housings with round leg columns and round blue glass/pipes; the feet are low dark blades with a raised blue rim.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: square blue light about 4 x 4 px at cols 21-24, rows 1-4
glowing glass set in a grey frame of the head housing, flush or slightly raised, emissive blue
distinct from the tube below it, separated by the grey collar band (row 5)
features.note: Concept: a framed glowing square at the top of the housing.

traits: vertical glass cylinder about 3-4 px wide from row 6 to row 14, constant diameter, rounded end at the bottom
bright streak down its left-centre (col 22), darker right edge: round, standing about as tall as it is wide
glossy, emissive blue, set in a dark channel between the legs
features.note: The glowing core tube (concept: a glass tube in a capped frame).

traits: chamfered grey box cols 19-26, rows 1-5, the tallest part of the structure
grey collar band across it at row 5, crossing the light/tube line
shoulders sloping out to cols 16-29 at rows 6-7, lower than the head; the rows 7-8 dark band below is shadow
features.note: The cap that holds the light and the top of the tube.

traits: each leg's top is a round grey hip about 5 px wide (cols 15-19, rows 9-12), mirrored at cols 26-30
round across (bright ridge col 17 / col 28), about as tall as wide, a ring band where the leg starts
a small blue light spot on the hip where the pipe leaves it
features.note: Concept: domed hip caps with ring bands on top of the leg columns.

traits: round grey leg column cols 15-17, rows 12-20, mid grey, mirrored
highlight streak down col 17 (a cylinder), constant width, sloping lower toward the foot
a blue trim strip down its inner edge (col 17 / 28), rows 15-23
features.note: The shins running down from the hips to the feet.

traits: blue pipe of constant diameter (about 1 px) leaving the hip at row 11, running out to col 13 and down col 13 to row 16, then back into the leg
a pipe, round, with bends, not a flat strip or a chain of bulges; mirrored at col 32
features.note: Concept: the blue conduit that loops out from the hip and back into the leg.

traits: foot flaring out to col 12 at rows 20-26, a low dark grey blade (sprite 2-5), not a blue box
raised blue rim along its outer and bottom edge (cols 12-13 and rows 24-25)
lowest part of the leg, standing on the ground; mirrored on the right
features.note: Concept: curved axe-blade feet with glowing blue trim.

traits: recessed dark bay between the legs, rows 13-19, cols 19-26
holds machinery: a dark gear disc and a short grey shaft at col 23 (rows 15-18)
low, darker than the legs; reads as depth, not flat black floor
features.note: Concept: gears and a crank in the bay below the tube.
